primary_name: Kelly DeVries, Joan of Arc: A Military Leader
summary: Study arguing that Joan should be studied first as a soldier.
bias_notes: No bias noted in the pilot doc.
title: Joan of Arc: A Military Leader
reliability_notes: Specialist in medieval military history; the key study for this database's angle. Known from reviews only: H-Net review (https://phdn.org/archives/www.ess.uwe.ac.uk/genocide/reviewsw150.htm) and Project MUSE review (https://muse.jhu.edu/article/170578/pdf). One reviewer notes the book still leaves open what exactly made her effective.
